dataset: 5,183 Natural Product Spectra (train.parquet RG 10 GNPS/MassBank, RG 18 RIKEN, RG 20 Enveda-NP)
key_findings: Formate adducts [M+CH2O2-H]- exhibit 52.2% HCOOH loss (46.01 Da) regenerating [M-H]- precursor; essential for negative-mode natural product identification.
Ammonium adducts [M+NH4]+ display 18.2% NH3 loss (17.03 Da), occurring at 12x higher frequency than alkali adducts.
Negative mode [M-H]- exhibits 7x higher CO2 loss (11.2%) than [M+H]+, uniquely diagnosing phenolic and carboxylic natural product scaffolds.
Alkali adducts [M+Na]+ and [M+K]+ strongly suppress mobile proton cleavage (< 2.8% H2O/NH3 loss).
High specificity (>95%) across all losses confirms that observed neutral loss peaks reliably rule out incompatible decoys.
